# QCAD MCP - Full Server Documentation

## Overview

QCAD MCP is a FastMCP 3.4 server that provides AI-driven 2D CAD automation. It turns natural-language CAD goals into real DXF/DWG drawings, previews, and 3D STL meshes. Runs on port 11966 (backend/REST API) with webapp at port 11967.

Key capabilities: DXF/DWG parsing with ezdxf, SVG/PNG/PDF preview generation, wall extrusion to 3D STL, room/area analysis, DXF creation from primitives, persistent file depot with full CRUD, QCAD Pro ECMAScript bridge for advanced operations (dimensions, hatches, text, measurements, arrays, block insertion), AutoLISP-to-ECMAScript transpilation, CAD block library search, and structural beam analysis.

Two-tier engine: ezdxf 1.4 (pure Python, no binary deps) for core operations, plus optional QCAD Pro 3.x for DWG support, native rendering, and the full ECMAScript API.

## Quick Start

MCP client config (Claude Desktop, Cursor):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "qcad-mcp": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["run", "--directory", "C:\\path\\to\\qcad-mcp", "python", "-m", "qcad_mcp.server", "--mode", "dual", "--port", "11966"],
      "env": {
        "QCAD_PRO_PATH": "C:\\Program Files\\QCAD"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Start standalone: `uv run python -m qcad_mcp.server --mode dual --port 11966`

Start with webapp: `powershell -File start.ps1`

## Tools (v0.5.0 — 8 portmanteaus + 4 Prefab cards)

Each portmanteau takes an `op` discriminator plus the op's parameters.

### plan — core ezdxf (no QCAD Pro needed)

- `plan(op="info", file_name)` -- DXF metadata: layers, entity counts, bbox, blocks, DXF version.
  Example: await plan(op="info", file_name="floorplan.dxf")

- `plan(op="to_svg", file_name, output_name, svg_layers, background)` -- DXF to SVG preview via ezdxf+matplotlib. Layer filter + custom background.
  Example: await plan(op="to_svg", file_name="floorplan.dxf", svg_layers=["Walls", "Windows"])

- `plan(op="extrude", file_name, output_name, wall_height, wall_thickness, wall_layers, base_elevation, slab, slab_thickness)` -- Walls to 3D STL mesh. Auto-detects layers named "wall", "mauer", "wand", "mur", "parete", "pared". Default h=3.0m, t=0.3m.
  Example: await plan(op="extrude", file_name="floorplan.dxf", wall_height=2.5, wall_thickness=0.2)

- `plan(op="export", file_name, format, output_name)` -- DXF to SVG, PDF, PNG. QCAD Pro first, ezdxf fallback.
  Example: await plan(op="export", file_name="floorplan.dxf", format="pdf")

- `plan(op="analyse", file_name)` -- Rooms (closed LWPOLYLINE), areas, perimeters, doors/windows by block name. Sorted by area desc.
  Example: await plan(op="analyse", file_name="floorplan.dxf")

- `plan(op="create", filename, entities, layers, description)` -- DXF from primitives: line, rect, circle, text, polyline.
  Example: await plan(op="create", filename="room.dxf", entities=[{"type": "rect", "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 10000, "h": 8000, "layer": "Walls"}])

- `plan(op="depot")` -- Depot files with metadata (size, modified date, description, tags, entity count).
  Example: await plan(op="depot")

- `plan(op="stack", files, ...)` -- Multi-storey extrusion. `plan(op="obj"|"glb", ...)` -- OBJ/GLB shuttles (Resonite path). `plan(op="drawings", ...)` -- elevations/section/iso/roof set.

### plan_edit — convert + modify

- `plan_edit(op="convert", file_name, output_name)` -- DWG<->DXF via QCAD Pro CLI.
  Example: await plan_edit(op="convert", file_name="plan.dwg", output_name="plan.dxf")

- `plan_edit(op="modify", file_name, operations)` -- delete, offset, layer-set-color, layer-rename, layer-freeze/thaw, layer-lock/unlock, merge-layers.
  Example: await plan_edit(op="modify", file_name="plan.dxf", operations=[{"op": "delete", "type_filter": "TEXT"}])

### plan_annotate — dimensions, text, hatches, blocks, arrays, BIM data

- `plan_annotate(op="dimension", file_name, dimensions, output_name)` -- aligned, rotated, radial, diametric, angular.
  Example: await plan_annotate(op="dimension", file_name="floorplan.dxf", dimensions=[{"type": "aligned", "x1": 0, "y1": 0, "x2": 5000, "y2": 0, "xd": 2500, "yd": -500}])

- `plan_annotate(op="measure", file_name)` / `plan_annotate(op="wall_data", file_name, wall_layers, wall_thickness)` / `plan_annotate(op="beam_analysis", beams, supports, loads)` -- measure (geometry engine), wall BIM JSON for freecad-mcp, numpy FEM (moments, shear, deflection).
  Example: await plan_annotate(op="wall_data", file_name="floorplan.dxf")

- `plan_annotate(op="text"|"hatch"|"block_insert"|"array", ...)` -- text annotations (align/rotation/bold), hatch patterns (ANSI31-38, AR-CONC, SOLID, …), block INSERTs, rectangular/polar arrays.

### plan_bim — BIM handoff

- `plan_bim(op="auto_dimension"|"building_meta"|"to_ifc_data", ...)` -- wall auto-dimensioning, storey metadata, IFC-shaped wall data.

### plan_pro — QCAD Pro (check qcad(op="status") first)

- `plan_pro(op="script"|"render"|"exec", code, file_name, format, output_name)` -- arbitrary ECMAScript (`document` + `di` pre-bound, 120 s), hi-fi SVG/PDF/BMP, quick snippets.
  Example: await plan_pro(op="exec", code="document.queryAllEntities().length;", file_name="floorplan.dxf")

### plan_library — blocks + scripts

- `plan_library(op="blocks"|"blocks_download"|"scripts_search"|"scripts_download", ...)` -- 4800+ blocks (cadblocksfree, biblocad, gallery), gallery/Gist/bundled scripts.
  Example: await plan_library(op="blocks", query="sofa", category="furniture", limit=10)

### plan_ai — natural language + transpilation

- `plan_ai(op="generate", goal, filename, model, create_dxf)` -- floor-plan DXF from a text brief (local LLM fallback).
- `plan_ai(op="agentic", goal, file_name)` -- NL goal → ECMAScript → executed (sampling; template fallback).
- `plan_ai(op="transpile", lisp_code, output_name)` -- AutoLISP → ECMAScript.
- `plan_ai(op="sampling", goal)` -- host-LLM reasoning about a CAD question.

### qcad — server + Prefab cards

- `qcad(op="status")` -- install/running/version. `qcad(op="help", topic)` -- live catalog. `qcad(op="shutdown", confirm=True)` -- orderly exit.
- `show_qcad_status_card()`, `show_depot_card()`, `show_beam_analysis_card()`, `show_building_meta_card()` -- rich in-chat cards.

## REST additions

- `POST /api/shutdown` -- orderly exit for the fleet launcher (200 first, exit 500 ms later).
- `GET /api/skills` -- serves skills/*/SKILL.md for skill-first chat.
- `GET /api/tools` -- portmanteau tool catalog (name, description, ops, params) for the Tools page.
- `GET /api/llm/discover` -- Ollama :11434 / LM Studio :1234 / vLLM :8000 presence + models.
- `GET /api/llm/onboarding` -- starter facts + recommended path for the Dashboard cue.
- `POST /api/llm/chat` + `POST /api/llm/chat/stream` (SSE, OpenAI-style chunks) -- backend chat proxy; keys never leave the server.
- `GET /api/v1/files` -- uploads/outputs with size_kb + modified timestamps (Inbox feed).

## Prompts

Three registered @mcp.prompt() templates:

- `cad_expert(topic)` -- CAD expertise and tool guidance, optionally scoped.
  Example: cad_expert(topic="wall extrusion")

- `cad_analyse_plan(file_name)` -- 4-step workflow: plan(op="info") -> plan(op="to_svg") -> plan(op="analyse") -> summarise.
  Example: cad_analyse_plan(file_name="floorplan.dxf")

- `cad_extrude_3d(file_name, height, thickness)` -- plan(op="extrude") -> download -> Resonite/Unity3D/Blender.
  Example: cad_extrude_3d(file_name="floorplan.dxf", height=3.0, thickness=0.3)

## Resources

Two registered @mcp.resource() endpoints:

- `cad://depot` -- depot files with metadata (name, size_kb, modified date, description, tags, entity count).
  Example: resources/read?uri=cad://depot

- `cad://depot/{filename}` -- detailed info for one file.
  Example: resources/read?uri=cad://depot/floorplan.dxf

## Architecture

Two-tier engine: ezdxf 1.4 (pure Python) handles reading, SVG export, extrusion, room analysis, DXF creation, depot management, entity/layer modification. QCAD Pro 3.x provides the ECMAScript bridge (dimensions, measurements, hatches, text, blocks, arrays, wall data, agentic workflows, transpilation), DWG conversion, native rendering.

Transport: MCP stdio (Claude Desktop) and HTTP (port 11966). REST API at /api/v1/ for file upload/download and depot management. Webapp at port 11967 (22 pages: Dashboard, Demo, Chat, Inbox, Tools, Skills, Depot, Viewer, Extrude, Analyse, Layers, Blocks, Scripts, Agentic, Batch, Pipeline, Playground, Models, Apps, Logs, Settings, Help).

Depot: persistent storage at %LOCALAPPDATA%/qcad-mcp/depot. Depot CRUD via REST: GET/PUT/DELETE /api/v1/depot/{name}. Outputs in a parallel output directory.

CORS: explicit origins (11967 on localhost/goliath, Tauri hosts) plus an unconditional regex for Tauri WebView, Tailscale CGNAT (100.x), and LAN (192.168.x, 10.x). Same-origin /api via the Vite proxy in dev; absolute backend URL only inside the Tauri WebView.

## Fleet Integration

QCAD MCP integrates with freecad-mcp via wall BIM JSON (bim_create_wall) and STL output (importable into freecad-mcp, godot-mcp, resonite-mcp, blender-mcp). Also integrates with inkscape-mcp for SVG post-processing.

## Error Handling

Common errors and recovery:

- "QCAD Pro not installed. Set QCAD_PRO_PATH env var." -- plan_pro and QCAD-backed annotate ops need QCAD Pro 3.x (e.g. C:\Program Files\QCAD).

- "File not found in depot: {name}" -- upload via POST /api/v1/upload, create via plan(op="create"), or list with plan(op="depot").

- "No wall entities found" -- plan(op="extrude") found no LINE/LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE on wall layers. Pass wall_layers explicitly or use layers matching "wall"/"mauer"/"wand".

- SVG rendering failed -- typically a matplotlib backend issue. Ensure matplotlib is installed with Agg backend support.

- DWG/DXF conversion failed -- requires QCAD Pro CLI. Verify QCAD_PRO_PATH and qcad.exe/qcadcmd.exe.

- "Sampling failed" or "AI sampling unavailable" -- plan_ai sampling/agentic/transpile fall back to template/heuristic mode without a sampling-capable client.

- "No beam segments provided" -- plan_annotate(op="beam_analysis") needs beams with x1,y1,x2,y2. Use the example format.

- "Missing required parameters for this op: ..." -- each op lists what it needs; the error names the missing keys.
